content: Jisas kin miyeꞌ embepteme lenge worsip

Jisas ŋanange na, “Ŋam mana yip bwore mise. Miyeꞌ endei topoꞌe miyeꞌ ŋaiye bule ŋonombe kete ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe miyeꞌ ende pe, yukur ka yil yoto yukoh map tikin lem lenge worsip. Kom ka taharꞌe lem yil juh umbur ŋaiye ka yil yoto.
Miyeꞌ ŋaiye nato yukoh map pe, kin miyeꞌ embepteme lenge worsip.
Miyeꞌ ŋaiye gan keteme kohmap pe, ki kumbur kohmap me kin. Lenge worsip yisande diꞌ kin ŋaiye kin gal lenge naŋ ilyeh ilyeh pe, kin nenge lenge nate tas.
Ŋupe ŋaiye kin si nenge lenge nate tas miꞌe pe, kin nal yerme tinge, kut lenge worsip jande kin. Detale, tinge si sisyeme diꞌ wonge kin.
Tinge yukur ka se plihe junde miyeꞌ ŋoinde. Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ka gil lenge pe, lenge worsip ka jirnge kin yil. Detale, tinge yukur sisyeme diꞌ wonge kin.”
Jisas ŋana lenge wusyep tap eꞌe, kom tinge yukur sisyeme ŋaimune ŋaiye kin ŋanange.
Taꞌe luku pe, Jisas plihe ŋanange na, “Ŋam mana yip bwore mise. Ŋam kohmap titinge lenge worsip.
Lenge mitiŋ lalme ŋaiye yat yer me ŋam pe, tinge mitiŋ ŋaiye yende ŋendei, topoꞌe lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye bule yonombe jete ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lenge mitiŋ. Kom lenge worsip yukur yisande wonge tinge.
Ŋam kohmap. Lahmende ŋaiye ka oto ŋam pe, Got ka ungwisme kin. Pe kin ka ote tus ŋaiye ka ambaꞌe ŋai.
Tehei ŋaiye miyeꞌ endei nat pe, kin nat ŋaiye ka ende ŋendei lenge worsip, topoꞌe ka ongombe ende yumbune ŋaiye ka yule. Kom ŋaiye ŋam pe, ŋam mat ŋaiye ma mende yip pa yurp bwore supule nye nyermbe.
Ŋam miyeꞌ embepteme bwore titinge lenge worsip. Miyeꞌ embepteme bwore titinge worsip pe, kin se ka aŋaꞌe laip kitikin el ŋaiye ka ungwis lenge worsip.

Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ŋende wah wuhyau ŋilyehme, kut kin yukur miyeꞌ embepteme mise lenge worsip, topoꞌe kin yukur yai tehei lenge worsip pe, ŋupe ŋaiye ka etekeꞌe ŋumbwat telpei ka ot pe, kin se ka osme lenge worsip, kut se ka girnge. O ŋumbwat telpei se ka kukwame lenge worsip elꞌe elꞌe pe, se ka ongomb lenge worsip syeꞌ ono.
Miyeꞌ uku se ka ende tuꞌe luku. Detale, kin ŋende wah wuhyau ŋilyehme. Kin yukur ŋoiheryembe lenge worsip.
Ŋam miyeꞌ embepteme bwore lenge worsip. Ŋam sisyeme lenge worsip ŋam. Topoꞌe lenge worsip ŋam tinge sisyeme ŋam.
Kin ŋahilyeh taꞌe ŋaiye Yai kin sisyeme ŋam, topoꞌe ŋam sisyeme Yai. Topoꞌe ŋam masande ŋaiye ma maŋaꞌe laip ŋam ŋaiye ma mungwisme lenge worsip.

Worsip syeꞌ tinge tanam, kom tinge yukur jan ya yoto lem eꞌe. Ŋam ma meleŋeime lenge menge mute moto topoꞌe. Tinge ka yisyunde diꞌ ŋaiye wonge ŋam. Pe lenge worsip uku ka lalme jin ŋilyeh, topoꞌe miyeꞌ embepteme ilyeh ŋaiye ka embepteme tinge lalme.
Yai kin ŋende nihararme ŋam. Detale, ŋam masande ma maŋaꞌe laip ŋam no, ma mule, kom se ma plihe tuhur murp.

Yukur lahende tatame ŋaiye ka se ongohe laip bwore ŋam. Ŋaiye ŋasande ŋam tanam pe, ma mule. Bongol ŋam sai ŋaiye ma mule, topoꞌe bongol ŋam sai ŋaiye ma plihe tuhur murp. Yai ŋam si ŋanange bongol, nange ma mende tuꞌe luku.”
Lenge Juta yisande wusyep uku pe, tinge plihe yoworꞌe tititinge yal hoime.
Lenge mitiŋ wula yanange na, “Yipihinge pupwa narp kin. Kin taꞌe kwote leꞌe. Yip yember mungwim yalme wusyep kin tale?”
Kom syeꞌ yanange na, “Miyeꞌ ŋaiye yipihinge pupwa narp kin pe, yukur ka se ininge wusyep tuꞌe leꞌe. O yipihinge pupwa se ka ende bworerme ŋembep lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye si tangar tuꞌe la?”
Lenge Juta yende wachaihme Jisas
Ŋup uku pe, wundehei tikin mwate pe, ŋup embere ende ŋaiye lenge mitiŋ yate jahilyeh yarp Jerusalem. Ŋup uku tinge ŋoiheryembe yal ŋaiye somohon tinge yalaŋatme yukoh yirise luku yalme Got.
O Jisas kin nange nal ŋoto lem wicherꞌ ŋaiye yukoh yirise nal yukoh yohe tikin Solomon.
Lenge Juta yate jan yoyorꞌme kin pe, tinge yisilihme na, “Tumboiyaꞌ tikin ŋaiye na ini poi el halhale ŋaiye nin lahmende? Na ini poi bwore mise ŋaiye nin Miyeꞌ nalaŋatme Krais lakai?”
Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Ŋam si mana yip miꞌe, kom ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur teŋeime ŋam. Wah lalme ŋaiye ŋam mende moto naŋ Yai ŋam pe, luku ki yasam yip ŋaiye ŋam lahmende.
Kom yip yukur worsip ŋam, taꞌe luku pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur teŋeime ŋam.
Worsip ŋam yisande diꞌ ŋaiye wonge ŋam. Ŋam sisyeme tinge pe, tinge jande ŋam.
Ŋam mangang lenge laip bwore ŋaiye sai nye nyermbe pe, yukur ka yule. Topoꞌe yukur lahende ka se ongohe tinge angaꞌme syep ŋam.
Yai ŋam ki ŋembere taharꞌe miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme. Lahmende tinge ŋaiye Yai pwale pe, yukur miyeꞌ ende ka se ongohe tinge angaꞌme syep ŋam.
Yai topoꞌe ŋam pe, poi hindi ŋaisep ilyeh.”
Miꞌe pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge plihe yambaꞌe ŋeser ŋaiye yala yiche yonombe Jisas.
Jisas ŋana lenge na, “Ŋam si mende wah bwore wula wula ŋaiye Yai pwale nange ma mende guh ŋembep yip. O wah mune bwore luku ŋaiye ŋam mende ti, yip yala yiche ŋeser pumbe?”

Lenge Juta yungwisme wusyep kin na, “Poi yukur mala miche ŋeser yumbe ŋaiye ni ŋende ŋaimune bwore, pakai. Kom nin ŋanange wusyep pupwa gonombaiꞌe Got. Nin miyeꞌ pakaiye leꞌe, kom nin nala ende nitei el tuꞌe ŋaiye na ambaꞌe luh Got.”
Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Yainge ŋaiye sai nato wusyep erŋeme yip pe, wusyep tikin Got sai taꞌe leꞌe, ‘Ŋam manange taꞌe leꞌe, yip taꞌe got’.

Poi sisyeme nange wusyep ŋaiye sai nato Tup tikin Got, ki bwore mise supule, topoꞌe yukur ki bunje bunjenge. Topoꞌe somohon Got nangange wusyep erŋeme nal me lenge miyeꞌ embep titinge Juta pe, kin gal lenge nange tinge taꞌe got.
O ŋaiye ŋam pe, Yai nalaŋatme ŋam pe, kin nember ŋam mate gwah kekep. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋupe ŋaiye ŋam manange nange ŋam Talah tikin Got pe, detaꞌe lai ti ŋaiye yip yanange nange ŋam gwonombaiꞌe Got?
Ŋaiye yukur ŋam mende wah me Yai ŋam pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur ka teŋeime ŋam.

Kom ŋam mende wah me kin. Kut ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip yip yukur teŋeime wusyep ŋam pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip ka teŋeime mirakel ŋaiye ŋam mende. Taꞌe luku pe, yip pa sisyeme bworerme nange Yai kin narp nato ŋam, topoꞌe ŋam marp ma moto Yai.”
Tinge yala syep yurpe Jisas ninde topoꞌe, kom kin syul tas syep tinge nal.
Jisas plihe nal nerŋe nal mih Jordan. Kin na gere luh ŋaiye somohon Jon gihyeꞌe pinip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, kin narp uku.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge wula yatme kin pe, tinge yanange na, “Bwore mise, Jon yukur ŋende mirakel ende. Kom wusyep lalme ŋaiye kin ŋanange nalme miyeꞌ eꞌe pe, ki bwore mise.”
Pe ŋoihmbwaip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge wula wula ŋaiye jan uku teŋeime kin.
